conclusion: PHYSICAL / CAMERA CAPTURE. Session m10-baseline-01-20261108T112241Z from iPhone14,2 (Continuity Camera, 'Arsh Camera') capturing a Apple M5 built-in Liquid Retina (MacBook Air): 888 camera samples, 549 passed the frame CRC (61.8%); 255/255 unique displayed frames (100.0%). Mean cell accuracy 1.000 and bit accuracy 1.000 over 255 unique frames with a display mapping. A complete payload of 317 bytes was recovered from 294 compressed bytes (1.08x) and its SHA-256 matched the transmitted payload. At the observed 10.00 display fps the gross channel rate is 1200 bps, the gross payload rate is 880 bps, the RS(255,223) goodput is 769 bps and the SHA-verified application rate is 99 bps. Decode latency 7.09 ms per camera sample, packet decode + reassembly 2.15 ms, decode throughput 141.1 samples/s. All physical numbers come from the preserved camera files; decoding is software. Compare with E01–E10 only through the comparison table, which states the basis of every pair.
